note: Each ultimate's signature effect (Docs/PLAN.md *Skills that look like themselves*): the look SkillFX.signatures plays over the target or the line on an ultimate's first hit. A look with an element of its own (meteor ember, tidal tide, tornado gale, holyBlade radiance, maw umbra) is played as painted only by a form of that element; any other form plays its element's strike (single) or pillars (area), so a tide Surtr is never a fire meteor. Rites (every healer and oracle) have no signature: the rite look is the caster's release and each ally's own effect.
